ABOUT_DESC:
Hi! I'm **Naura Hoshino**, built by **Aryandita** for Discord communities.

Here's what I can do:

**🤖 AI Chat**
Powered by Google Gemini. Holds conversation context across messages.

**🎶 Music Playback**
Streams audio via *Lavalink*. Supports YouTube, SoundCloud, and Spotify.

**💰 RPG Economy**
Rotating shops, inventory, fishing, car racing, and bank heists.

**🎙️ Temp Voice Rooms**
Creates private voice channels on demand with a control panel (lock, hide, stage mode).

**🛡️ Moderation**
Anti-nuke, automod, and message filters.

Type `/core help` to see all commands. ✨

HELP_CONTENT_CORE:
{emoji:help_core|⚙️} **Core System Commands & Machine Telemetry**

• `/core ping` / `n!ping` : Discord gateway websocket latency and database roundtrip
• `/core stats` / `n!stats` : Server hardware metrics (CPU, RAM, Shards, Node.js, Uptime)
• `/core about` / `n!about` : Platform overview, bot architecture, and developers
• `/core partner` / `n!partner` : Community partnership program and official partner listings
• `/core language` / `n!language` : Interface language configuration (Bahasa Indonesia / English)
• `/core help` / `n!help` : Interactive help handbook and command lookup system
HELP_CONTENT_NAURA:
{emoji:help_naura|🌸} **Naura Hoshino Companion Interaction**

• `/naura about` / `n!naura about` - Naura Hoshino profile: personality, lore, and hobbies
• `/naura talk` / `n!naura talk` - Casual chat, give gifts, and increase affection level
• `/naura room [user]` / `n!naura room` - Naura's 2.5D isometric living room and furniture setup
• `/naura gallery` / `n!naura gallery` - Exclusive pose photograph collection (VIP Access)
• `/naura play` / `n!naura play` - Casual 1v1 minigames with Naura (RPS, Number Guess)
HELP_CONTENT_AI:

• `/ai search <query>` - Real-time web-assisted information retrieval
• `/ai settings` - Configure bot persona and server FAQ knowledge base (Admins)
• `/ai mystery` - Interactive mystery solving game guided by AI

• `/ai story-mode` - Branching interactive narrative adventure roleplay

• `/ai voice` - Interactive voice conversations in voice channels

HELP_CONTENT_MUSIC:

HELP_CONTENT_ADMIN:
{emoji:help_admin|🛠️} **Administrator Configuration & Moderation**

**Master Setup (Unified Dashboard):**
• `/setup` - All-in-one Components V2 control dashboard for Greetings, Modmail, Automod, Tickets, TempVoice, Starboard, Auto-Role, Vanity Roles, Global Chat, Minecraft, Sticky, Announcements, and Auto Responder.

**Moderasi & Safety:**
• `/moderation panic` - Emergency anti-raid server lockdown or restore permissions
• `/moderation purge` - Bulk message deletion up to 1000 messages safely
• `/moderation nuke` - Reclone and clean this text channel instantly
• `/moderation roleall` - Grant or revoke roles for all server members
• `/warn add/check/remove/clear` - Manage member rule violation warning logs
• `/voicemod mute/unmute/kick/move` - Rapid voice channel moderation controls
• `/lockdown channel/server` - Lock down channels or entire server in emergencies
• `/sticky set/remove` - Pin persistent important notices to channel bottom
• `/slowmode <duration>` - Apply channel message rate limits for active discussions
• `/nickname` - Change server member nicknames instantly
• `/steal emoji` - Clone and add emojis from other guilds to this server
• `/announce` - Publish scheduled announcements to community channels
• `/reactionrole` - Setup automatic role assignment via message reactions
• `/report` - Member reporting hub to submit tickets to server staff
• `/audit <action>` - Fetch and view audit log entries directly
• `/qotd` - Question of the Day community engagement scheduler
• `/giveaway` / `/shield` / `/roleShop` - Manage giveaways, anti-raid shield, and server role shop
HELP_CONTENT_SURVIVAL:

• `/survival study` - Study at Pratama academy for certifications and career advancements

**Combat Expeditions & Arena:**

• `/survival arena` / `duel` - Tactical coliseum combat and 1v1 PvP player duels
• `/survival pass` / `quest` - Progress 30-Tier monthly Season Battle Pass and daily bounties

**Unified Economy, Community & Clans:**
• `/survival wallet` - Unified tri-currency passport (NSF, Coin, Coupon), raffle, and novice aid
• `/survival bank` - Deposit, withdraw, term savings, and official currency exchange bridge (NSF <-> Coin)
• `/survival shop` / `market` - Purchase adventure equipment or inspect 3D properties
• `/survival auction` / `caravan` - Player auction house and merchant caravan trade missions
• `/survival family` - Form families, adopt, and manage shared household assets
• `/clan` / `/survival town` - Found clans, customize Guild Hall, and visit Town Square
• `/survival siege` / `federation` - Clan siege warfare for territories and inter-clan federations
• `/survival gallery` / `story` - Visual memory gallery and chronicle narrative lore chapters
